title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 6.104
exact_target: Determine the harmonic Koebe covering constant and, independently, the largest possible second analytic coefficient in the full normalized harmonic class.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2306104 (AMR-022-6104). CC BY 4.0.
W. K. Hayman and E. F. Lingham, Research Problems in Function Theory (2018), Problem 6.104, complete problem and update, harmonic-class notation preceding Problem6.103.

S. Ponnusamy and A. Sairam Kaliraj, On the Coefficient Conjecture of Clunie and Sheil-Small on Univalent Harmonic Mappings (2014), Section1, pp.1--2, definitions of $S_H$, $S_H^0$, and harmonic Jacobian.
